Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:
This post will hopefully be obsolete in a few days, but...

I called my distributor today to see if the Sabbat was in their warehouse
(and thus on its way to my store via UPS). The answer, surprise, was no.
Thus the Sabbat will not hit retailers' shelves on the advertised street
date. I would love to hear if any of you in other parts of the country
(or even my own) do get the Sabbat tomorrow. Then I can take up the
issue with my distributor. Incidentally, I live in Southern California.

Chris
